title: The message trigger is small and contained
assertion: The trigger is an inline Node 22 function with no dependency, network or VPC, 128 MB and a 3-second timeout, one environment variable, a role with only its own log group’s two write actions and no managed policy, invoked only by Cognito for this pool and account; an unknown source, a missing parameter or a thrown error returns the event unchanged (Cognito sends the fallback template) and logs one line of codes with no address; the function’s errors, throttles and fallbacks alarm the operator; a reset request whose code Cognito could not send for the trigger answers alike at its floor, and an invitation it could not send fails visibly
noFileReason: The handler runs in a fresh vm context on synthetic Cognito events, and the function is read from the synthesized template; no file.
